profile.name: Tomide Williams
profile.title: AI Product Marketing Manager & AI Growth Engineer
profile.tagline: I build AI voice agents, sales agents, marketing agents, and full-stack apps, then use them to drive real revenue growth.
profile.bio: I help businesses stop losing money to slow follow-up, missed calls, and manual work. I design go-to-market strategy and build the AI systems that run it, voice agents, chatbots, and CRM automation built with Claude Code, n8n, GoHighLevel, and ElevenLabs. The result is the same: leads get a fast answer, deals keep moving, and your team spends its time on work that needs a person. I have done this across AI, EdTech, SaaS, and HR-tech, and I bring both the marketing thinking and the hands-on building, so the strategy and the system are never out of sync.

projects.title: Custom Content Management System
projects.shortDescription: A fully custom-coded content platform that plans and tracks every piece of launch content months in advance across content, social, and design teams.
projects.brief: Our product launches usually take between three and four months, and coordinating everyone involved is becoming a real challenge. We have content, design, marketing, and other teams all working on different parts of the launch, but information is spread across different tools and conversations. It's difficult to know who's working on what, what has been completed, what's behind schedule, and what needs attention. We'd like one central system where everyone can work together, manage tasks, track progress, and have complete visibility throughout the entire launch process.

implementation.title: Understand how the team really works
implementation.detail: We spent time with the content, social, and design teams to understand how launches are planned from start to finish. We mapped every stage of the process, identified where work slowed down, where information got lost, and where teams depended on manual follow-ups to move work forward.

implementation.title: Design one shared workflow
implementation.detail: Instead of forcing the team into a generic project management tool, we designed a workflow around how Koppoh already operates. Every launch now lives in one shared workspace, giving each team the view they need while keeping everyone aligned on the same timeline.

implementation.title: Build the platform
implementation.detail: We developed the platform using Next.js and Supabase, creating a fast, collaborative workspace where tasks, approvals, deadlines, and progress update in real time. As work moves through the pipeline, everyone automatically sees the latest status without chasing updates.

implementation.title: Test, improve, and launch
implementation.detail: Before rolling it out across the team, we tested the system during real product launches, gathered feedback, and refined the workflows. The result is a platform that gives everyone a clear view of what's happening, reduces unnecessary meetings, and keeps launches moving from planning through execution.

before: Every Koppoh launch ran over a three to four-month period and involved the content, social, and design teams. Each team managed its work in different tools, making it difficult to keep everyone aligned.

Content briefs, social calendars, and design requests were all managed separately, so there was no single source of truth for the launch. As deadlines approached, it became increasingly difficult to know what had been completed, what was still in progress, and what was waiting on another team.
Weekly meetings were largely spent collecting updates and reconciling different plans instead of discussing the launch itself.
after: Every launch now has a dedicated workspace where the content, social, and design teams work from the same live launch plan.
Tasks, approvals, and project status update automatically as work progresses, giving everyone real-time visibility without relying on manual updates.
At any point during a launch, the team can immediately see what has been completed, what is currently in progress, what is overdue, and what is waiting on another team, all from a single workspace.
The result was a 40%+ improvement in team productivity and more than 10 hours per week returned to the team by reducing manual coordination, status reporting, and unnecessary meetings.
projects.whyThisApproach: A generic project management platform would have solved only part of the problem. The bigger cost was asking three teams to change how they worked just to fit the software. Koppoh needed a system built around its existing launch process, not the other way around. Building a custom platform meant every workflow, approval, and handoff reflected how the business already operated, giving all three teams one shared source of truth without changing the way they worked.

impact.headline: A 40%+ increase in team productivity across content, social, and design, with the weekly status sync eliminated.
benefits: One shared source of truth for every launch, so no brief, request, or piece of content is ever lost between teams again.
No more meetings held just to find out what's already done, the plan answers that question on its own.
The system scales to any number of future launches, each with its own dedicated workspace.

keyFeatures: A single launch timeline that keeps every team working from the same plan, with updates reflected in real time as work progresses.
Automatic progress tracking that updates as tasks move through each stage, eliminating manual status updates and reducing the need for follow-up.
Dedicated workspaces for content, social, and design, giving each team the tools they need while keeping everyone aligned on the overall launch.

projects.title: Marketing & Sales Analytics Dashboard
projects.shortDescription: A live, custom-built dashboard that pulls sales and marketing activity into one view, replacing scattered spreadsheets and manual reporting.
projects.brief: Our marketing and sales teams each work from different systems, so leadership never has a complete picture of how the business is performing. Every week, someone has to export reports, combine spreadsheets, and manually prepare updates just to answer simple questions. By the time those reports are ready, some of the information is already outdated. We need one dashboard that brings everything together automatically, so we can see the entire customer journey in one place without relying on manual reporting.

implementation.title: Understand the reporting process
implementation.detail: We met with the leadership, marketing, and sales teams to understand how reports were being prepared, where the data came from, and which business questions they needed answered every week.

implementation.title: Design one source of truth
implementation.detail: We designed a dashboard that brings marketing and sales together into one live view, making it easy to track the customer journey from the first interaction through to conversion.

implementation.title: Build and connect the platform
implementation.detail: The dashboard was built with Next.js and Recharts, then connected to the team's existing data sources so information updates automatically as new activity happens.

implementation.title: Test and roll out
implementation.detail: Before replacing the manual reporting process, we validated the live dashboard against the team's existing reports to ensure the numbers matched. Once verified, the dashboard became the team's primary reporting tool.

before: Marketing and sales worked from different systems, making it difficult to understand how the business was performing as a whole.
Every week, someone had to export reports from multiple platforms, combine the data manually, and prepare a summary for leadership.
By the time reports were ready, the information was often several days old, making it difficult to respond quickly to changes in performance.
after: Leadership now has one dashboard that combines marketing and sales into a single live view.
The dashboard updates automatically throughout the day, giving everyone access to the latest information without waiting for weekly reports.
Instead of spending hours preparing reports, the team can immediately see performance, identify issues, and focus on making better business decisions.
projects.whyThisApproach: The problem wasn't that the business lacked reports—it already had them. The real issue was that every report depended on someone manually gathering information from different systems before anyone could make a decision. Rather than improving the reporting process, we removed it. By connecting the existing data sources into one live dashboard, leadership always has access to accurate, up-to-date information without waiting for someone to prepare it. That means less time reporting and more time making decisions.

impact.headline: One live dashboard across marketing and sales, eliminating 5–8 hours of weekly reporting and up to 90% of manual reporting work.

metrics.label: Time saved weekly
metrics.description: The time previously spent exporting, cleaning, and combining reports is now almost entirely eliminated.

metrics.label: Manual reporting
metrics.description: Most reporting now happens automatically, reducing repetitive administrative work across the team.

metrics.label: Cross-team visibility
metrics.description: Leadership can now see the complete customer journey in one place instead of switching between multiple systems.

metrics.label: Business insights
metrics.description: Performance updates automatically as new data comes in, so decisions are based on current information instead of last week's reports.

metrics.label: Answering questions
metrics.description: Business questions that previously required digging through multiple reports can now be answered almost instantly.

metrics.label: Source of truth
metrics.description: Everyone works from the same live data, reducing confusion, duplicate reporting, and conflicting numbers.

keyFeatures: 5–8 hours saved every week by eliminating manual report preparation.
Up to 90% reduction in reporting effort through automated dashboards.
One live dashboard combining marketing and sales into a single view.
Real-time visibility into the entire customer journey.
Faster decision-making using live business data instead of outdated reports.
Greater alignment across leadership, marketing, and sales with one shared source of truth.
Less time preparing reports, more time improving performance.

projects.title: AI Voice Agent for Sales
projects.shortDescription: An AI voice agent that calls new leads the moment they enter the CRM, holds a real conversation, and logs the outcome automatically.
projects.brief: New leads that need a follow-up call are sitting for hours, sometimes a day, before anyone gets to them. We need every lead called within minutes of entering the CRM, with a real conversation and the outcome captured and logged, no matter what time of day it happens.

implementation.title: Find the moment that matters
implementation.detail: Mapped the exact point in the pipeline where a lead needs a call, and what a great first contact actually sounds like when it lands.

implementation.title: Trigger the call automatically
implementation.detail: Built a flow in n8n that fires the second a lead needs a call, straight off a GoHighLevel webhook, so nothing depends on someone noticing.

implementation.title: Make the conversation real
implementation.detail: Wired in ElevenLabs so the agent places a real outbound call and holds a genuine conversation, not a script.

implementation.title: Close the loop in the CRM
implementation.detail: Connected the outcome logging back into GoHighLevel, with a follow-up text sent automatically when the call calls for it.

before: Leads that needed a follow-up call just sat until someone had time to make it, which often meant hours of delay before any real contact.
The businesses that convert best respond in minutes, not hours, and every hour of silence was a lead quietly going cold.
No one could guarantee a lead would ever be called, let alone called fast, because it all depended on whoever happened to be free.
The CRM only got an update if someone remembered to log the outcome after the call.
after: The moment a lead needs a call, the agent fires automatically and places a real conversation within seconds, around the clock.
It talks like a person rather than a script, answers questions, and judges what the lead is actually ready for.
The outcome is logged back into the CRM automatically, and a follow-up text goes out when it's called for, with zero human involvement.
No lead waits on a human being available anymore, and the sales team only steps in when there's a real conversation to have.
projects.whyThisApproach: Speed to first contact is one of the biggest levers in whether a lead converts at all, and hiring more people to sit and wait for calls was never realistic. An always-on agent was the only way to guarantee every lead gets reached within seconds instead of whenever someone was free. It also took the logging out of human hands, which meant the data finally became trustworthy, because it was captured by the thing that made the call, not remembered afterwards.

impact.headline: Every lead now gets a real call within seconds of needing one, day or night.
benefits: No lead waits on a human being available to call them.
Consistent, script-free follow-up on every single lead, in the same way every time.
The sales team is freed from repetitive outbound calls to focus on the conversations that actually matter.

keyFeatures: Instant automatic outbound calling the second a lead needs attention.
Real conversational AI that responds like a person, not a decision tree.
Automatic CRM logging and follow-up SMS, with no manual step in between.

projects.title: Full-Funnel CRM & Lead Scoring System
projects.shortDescription: A complete CRM build that scores every lead automatically, from application to enrollment, and shows the sales team exactly who to call first.
projects.brief: BOP prospects come in through applications, the community, webinars, and direct messages, and none of it is tracked in one place. We need a single CRM that scores every lead automatically, shows the sales team exactly who to call first, and moves people through a clear pipeline from application to enrollment.

implementation.title: Score on real signals
implementation.detail: Designed a scoring algorithm from engagement that actually predicts enrollment: applications, community activity, webinar check-ins, and direct inquiries, each weighted by strength.

implementation.title: Build the pipeline
implementation.detail: Built the full CRM natively in GoHighLevel around a clear six-stage pipeline, from applied to enrolled, so every prospect has a place.

implementation.title: Make webinars move leads
implementation.detail: Connected a webinar check-in automation that bumps a lead's score and advances their stage the moment they show up live.

implementation.title: Put the picture in front of sales
implementation.detail: Gave the team one view of where every prospect stands, so prioritization stopped being a memory exercise.

before: Prospects could come in through applications, the community, webinars, or direct messages, with no unified way to track them.
There was no lead scoring, so a barely-engaged lead looked the same on paper as someone ready to enroll.
With no pipeline visibility, sales worked off memory and gut feel instead of real signal.
Volume was already outgrowing the manual approach, and it was only going to get worse with each launch.
after: Every prospect is scored the moment they engage with BOP, and tagged hot, warm, or cold based on real behavior.
A clear six-stage pipeline shows exactly where each lead stands, from applied to enrolled, for anyone on the team.
Webinar attendance updates scores and pipeline stage in real time, during the event, not after it.
Sales always knows who to call first, because the system ranks the queue for them.
projects.whyThisApproach: Manual prioritization breaks down the moment volume goes up, and it was already breaking down before this was built. Scoring by hand means whoever remembers the name from a webinar gets called, not whoever is most likely to enroll. An automated scoring model gave the sales team a consistent, repeatable answer to who to call next, built from engagement signals that actually predict enrollment, and it stopped treating every prospect as though they were in the same place in the journey.

impact.headline: Sales sees exactly who's hottest, instantly, across the entire funnel.
benefits: Sales always knows who to call first, ranked by the system rather than by memory.
No more manually tracking prospects in spreadsheets that only one person ever updated.
Full visibility from first touch to enrollment, for the whole team, in real time.

keyFeatures: Automatic lead scoring that tags every prospect hot, warm, or cold from real engagement.
A six-stage pipeline that makes the whole journey visible at a glance.
Real-time webinar check-in automation that moves leads forward during the event itself.

projects.title: Paid Ads to CRM Automation
projects.shortDescription: Meta Ads campaigns that feed directly into an automated CRM and lead-scoring pipeline, no manual lead entry required.
projects.brief: Our Meta Ads bring in real leads, but every one of them has to be pulled out of the ads platform and typed into the CRM by hand. We need the ad account and the CRM wired together, so a lead is in the system, scored, and moving through the pipeline the moment they convert, with no manual step in between.

implementation.title: Connect the ad account to the CRM
implementation.detail: Wired the Meta Ads account directly into the GHL pipeline via API, removing the export-and-enter step entirely.

implementation.title: Score leads on arrival
implementation.detail: Connected inbound leads into the existing BOP scoring pipeline, so they're scored and staged the moment they land.

implementation.title: Remove every manual step
implementation.detail: Traced real leads through the whole flow and eliminated each point where a click could stop short of becoming a CRM record.

implementation.title: Verify against live data
implementation.detail: Tested the flow against real campaign traffic before trusting it, and now manage the campaigns themselves end to end.

before: Leads generated from Meta Ads had no automated path into the CRM.
Every lead had to be pulled manually from the ads platform and entered into the system by hand.
That meant real delay between when someone clicked and when anyone actually followed up.
And a quiet risk of leads getting missed entirely in the handoff between two systems.
after: The moment someone converts on an ad, they're in the CRM, scored, and moving through the pipeline automatically.
There is no manual step anywhere between a click and a working lead record.
Real results from a single campaign: 907 leads and 859 completed registrations, at a 6.70% click-through rate over a 40 day window.
Follow-up can start immediately, because the lead is actionable the second it exists.
projects.whyThisApproach: Manual entry from an ad platform into a CRM is slow, and it's exactly where leads quietly go missing. Every hand-typed export is a chance for a lead to fall between two systems and never be followed up. A direct connection meant every lead is actionable the instant they convert, not whenever someone got around to the export, and it gave the team real-time cost-per-lead visibility instead of end-of-week surprises.

impact.headline: 907 leads and 859 completed registrations from a single campaign, at a 6.70% click-through rate.
benefits: Zero manual lead entry between the ad platform and the CRM.
Faster follow-up on every paid lead, because it starts the instant the lead exists.
Clear, real cost-per-lead visibility, pulled straight from the live ad account.

keyFeatures: Direct ad-to-CRM integration with no manual data entry anywhere in the flow.
Real-time lead scoring the moment a lead arrives in the system.
Live campaign management with cost-per-lead visibility straight from the account.

projects.title: AI Content Research & Generation Engine
projects.shortDescription: A 10-stage automated pipeline that takes a single campaign brief from research to published, platform-ready content across four channels.
projects.brief: Getting one campaign from idea to published content takes days and ties up several people: research, competitive checks, trend spotting, then separate writers for every platform. We need the whole process to run itself, from a single brief to published, platform-ready content, with a human only in the loop where judgment actually matters.

implementation.title: Break the process into stages
implementation.detail: Took the full campaign process apart into ten discrete stages, from intake through research, strategy, writing, creative, QA, and approval.

implementation.title: Build each stage as a step
implementation.detail: Implemented every stage as its own connected step inside n8n, so a single campaign brief flows through the whole pipeline.

implementation.title: Automate the pre-writing work
implementation.detail: Wired in a Tavily-powered research agent, competitor analysis, and trend detection from Reddit, X, and YouTube, all before any content is written.

implementation.title: Keep judgment human
implementation.detail: Added image and video generation, an AI quality check, and a Telegram approval step, so a person still signs off before anything publishes.

before: Getting one campaign from idea to published content took days and needed several people.
Research, competitor analysis, and trend tracking each required their own human, all working in sequence.
Then separate writers had to cover LinkedIn, Twitter, email, and Instagram, each with their own tone and format.
Every step was manual, so every step was a bottleneck, and the campaign could only move as fast as the slowest person.
after: A single campaign brief now kicks off the whole pipeline, with research, competitor analysis, and trend detection running automatically before a word is written.
Content is drafted for LinkedIn, Twitter, email, and Instagram in parallel, each in its own tone and format.
Image and video creative generate next, followed by an AI quality check.
A human approves over Telegram, then it publishes automatically, collapsing a multi-person, multi-day workflow into one pipeline.
projects.whyThisApproach: The bottleneck was never the writing, it was everything that had to happen before a word got written: research, competitive context, and trend signal, all done manually and in sequence. Automating that meant the humans only touch the two parts that actually need judgment, quality review and final approval. The speed didn't come from faster writers, it came from the fact that the pipeline never had to wait on a person to make the next step happen.

impact.headline: A full campaign lifecycle now runs end to end through one pipeline, instead of a multi-person manual process.
benefits: Days of manual work compressed into a single automated run.
Consistent quality and tone across every platform, every time.
A human still approves everything before it goes live.

keyFeatures: A ten-stage automated pipeline that runs from brief to published content.
Multi-platform content generation in parallel, each piece in its own format and tone.
A built-in human approval step that keeps judgment exactly where it belongs.

projects.title: AI Chatbot for Lead Qualification
projects.shortDescription: A conversational AI chatbot that qualifies inbound leads and answers common questions instantly, day or night.
projects.brief: The same handful of questions keeps coming in: what the program covers, what it costs, when the next cohort starts. Every one lands on a real person, mostly during business hours, and anyone who reaches out after hours just waits. We need these repeat questions answered instantly, day or night, with genuinely interested leads qualified before they ever reach the team.

implementation.title: Train on real questions
implementation.detail: Trained the bot on the team's actual FAQs and the real qualification criteria they use, not generic answers.

implementation.title: Route into the pipeline
implementation.detail: Connected it directly to the existing lead pipeline, so qualified conversations move to the right next step automatically.

implementation.title: Test before launch
implementation.detail: Ran it against real visitor questions, tightening the responses until it handled the full range of ways people ask.

implementation.title: Cover the hours no one does
implementation.detail: Put it live around the clock, so coverage no longer depends on business hours or on headcount.

before: The same handful of questions came in over and over: what the program covers, how much it costs, when the next cohort starts.
Every one of them landed on a real person to answer, usually during business hours only.
Anyone who reached out outside those hours simply waited, and some of that interest never came back.
Each repeated answer was time a person wasn't spending on the leads that actually needed a real conversation.
after: Repeat questions are answered instantly by a conversational AI, day or night, without a human in the loop.
Genuinely interested leads get qualified as they talk, before they ever reach the team.
Qualified conversations route straight into the existing pipeline, to the right next step.
The team's time is now spent on the leads that need a real conversation, not the same question for the hundredth time.
projects.whyThisApproach: Every minute spent re-answering the same question is a minute not spent on the leads that actually need a real conversation. Automating the repeat questions freed the team for the ones that matter, and it closed the gap where interest outside business hours was going unanswered. The bot wasn't built to replace the team, it was built to absorb the workload that never should have been theirs in the first place.

impact.headline: 24/7 coverage of every repeat question, without adding a single person.
benefits: Coverage around the clock, not just during business hours.
Fewer repetitive questions landing on the team, so they keep their focus.
Faster qualification for the leads that genuinely matter.

keyFeatures: 24/7 automated coverage of common questions, with no wait for business hours.
Instant lead qualification built into the conversation itself.
Direct routing into the existing lead pipeline.

projects.title: GHL + Stripe Payment Automation
projects.shortDescription: A complete payment lifecycle system for tiered membership offers, activation, renewals, refunds, and dunning, fully automated.
projects.brief: A membership business runs on renewals, and renewals only survive if someone is watching them. We need the entire payment lifecycle automated: a $497 strategy session, a $1,500 activation, a $1,997 charge twice a year for renewal, plus e-signed agreements, refunds, failed payments, and reminders, so no one has to track any of it by hand. This build started from a real Upwork brief, taken on as a self-directed practice build to prove what a membership business actually needs.

implementation.title: Map the full lifecycle
implementation.detail: Mapped the entire three-tier payment journey, from signup and agreement through activation, renewal, refund, and dunning.

implementation.title: Build every payment state
implementation.detail: Built fifteen workflows in GHL covering every state a member could hit, including failed payments, overdue renewals, and anniversary charges.

implementation.title: Wire in the money
implementation.detail: Connected Stripe for the actual payment processing, and layered in e-signature membership agreements.

implementation.title: Prove it end to end
implementation.detail: Ran the whole system against the real Upwork brief, leaving 14 of 15 workflows live as a complete membership engine.

before: This build started from a real Upwork brief: a membership business that needed a way to handle a three-tier offer, $497 for a strategy session, $1,500 for activation, and $1,997 charged twice a year for renewal.
Without automation, someone had to track who had paid, who was overdue, and who needed a renewal reminder, all by hand.
That works for a handful of members, and breaks the moment the list grows.
Failed payments, refunds, and expired agreements each added another manual thread to chase.
after: The complete payment lifecycle now runs on its own: signup, e-signed agreement, activation, renewals, refunds, and failed payments, each handled by a dedicated workflow.
Nobody has to track who paid, who's overdue, or who's up for renewal, the system remembers.
Anniversary renewals charge on schedule, and dunning handles the members who need a nudge.
It's not a demo of a payment flow, it's the actual system a real membership business would run on.
projects.whyThisApproach: A subscription business built on someone manually tracking renewal dates in a spreadsheet doesn't scale past a handful of members, and the moment it breaks, the business stops collecting revenue it's already owed. The right system is automated from the moment someone signs up through every renewal after that. Building it as a complete, proven engine rather than a single checkout flow is what separates a real membership operation from a form with a payment button.

impact.headline: A full payment lifecycle automated for a three-tier membership offer, from $497 to $1,997, with 14 of 15 workflows live.
benefits: No more manually chasing renewals, refunds, or failed payments.
A consistent, professional payment experience for every member.
The system scales to any number of members without extra headcount.

keyFeatures: Fifteen automated payment workflows covering every state a member can hit.
E-signature membership agreements built into the flow.
Automatic dunning and renewal handling, with Stripe processing.

projects.title: Learning Management Platform
projects.shortDescription: A custom-built LMS for a content creator to host and sell her own courses directly to her audience, no platform fees.
projects.brief: I've built a real audience and I want to sell my own courses directly to them. Renting space on a platform like Teachable or Kajabi means paying fees on every sale forever, and I never really own my student data or the relationship. We need a platform that's mine, where students sign up, go through orientation, and learn, and where I keep full control of my content, my payments, and my students.

implementation.title: Design two experiences
implementation.detail: Designed the student portal and the admin portal as separate experiences, each built for its own user from the ground up.

implementation.title: Build the platform
implementation.detail: Coded it in Next.js with a Supabase backend, with its own authentication and a guided orientation flow for new students.

implementation.title: Deploy beside the brand
implementation.detail: Launched it alongside her existing marketing website, so the whole experience reads as one brand rather than a rented storefront.

implementation.title: Hand over ownership
implementation.detail: Delivered a platform she owns outright, with no per-seat fees and no dependency on a third-party template.

before: Blossom Affia had built a real audience and wanted to sell her own courses directly to them.
The usual path, renting space on a platform like Teachable or Kajabi, meant ongoing fees on every sale, forever.
It also meant no real ownership of student data, or of the relationship that comes with it.
She was paying to rent the storefront, the customer list, and the experience itself.
after: Her students now sign up and learn on a platform that is entirely hers, with her own signup, login, and orientation flow.
Course content is delivered through a dedicated student portal, and she manages everything from a separate admin dashboard.
She keeps full control of her student data, her payments, and how the experience looks and feels.
The platform sits beside her marketing website as one cohesive brand, not a rented template.
projects.whyThisApproach: Renting a platform meant paying indefinitely for something that could be owned outright, and it capped how much of the relationship she actually controlled. Building it custom meant she keeps full control of her student data, her payments, and how the experience actually looks and feels, instead of being boxed into someone else's template. For a creator whose audience is her business, ownership of that audience is the whole point.

impact.headline: Full ownership of the platform, the student data, and every payment, with platform fees eliminated.
benefits: No more platform fees eating into every sale.
Full ownership of student data and the relationship that comes with it.
A branded experience instead of a rented one.

keyFeatures: Separate student and admin portals, each built for its own user.
A custom signup, login, and orientation flow.
Fully owned and self-hosted, with no per-seat platform fees.

projects.title: AI SDR & Missed Revenue Recovery
projects.shortDescription: An always-on AI sales rep that answers, qualifies, negotiates, and books, plus instant callback automation for every missed call.
projects.brief: Every business that takes phone calls loses revenue to missed ones. We need a system that answers when we can't, qualifies the lead, handles objections, and books the appointment, and if a call does get missed, calls back within seconds. No call should ever go fully unanswered again.

implementation.title: Build the safety net first
implementation.detail: Created the missed-call recovery flow as the immediate fix: within seconds of any unanswered call, the system calls back and sends a text.

implementation.title: Lay in the live agent
implementation.detail: Added the full conversational AI sales agent that answers live calls, qualifies leads, handles objections, and books appointments on its own.

implementation.title: Connect everything to the CRM
implementation.detail: Wired the entire system into GoHighLevel, so every call, callback, and booking leaves a trace.

implementation.title: Package it as a capability
implementation.detail: Shaped it into a repeatable system that applies to any business fielding inbound calls, not a one-off integration.

before: A missed call is usually just lost revenue, with nothing in place to try to recover it once it's gone.
Most businesses can't staff a phone around the clock, so calls outside business hours simply go unanswered.
Even during hours, calls get missed, and whoever calls back later is already dealing with a colder lead.
There was no second chance built into the process: one ring, one shot.
after: A missed call now triggers an instant callback and text within seconds, before the caller has moved on.
Live calls are answered by a real conversational AI that qualifies, handles objections, updates the CRM, and books appointments on its own.
Every interaction logs automatically, so the record is always current and never depends on someone remembering.
No call goes fully unanswered, and no revenue quietly slips away through the phone.
projects.whyThisApproach: Adding staff to catch every missed call around the clock isn't realistic for most businesses, and it doesn't solve the calls that still get missed even when people are there. An automated recovery flow paired with a real conversational agent means no call goes fully unanswered, without needing a person watching the phone at all hours. The first call becomes a safety net, and the follow-up becomes a second chance the business never used to have.

impact.headline: A second chance on every missed call, and a live sales conversation on every answered one.
benefits: Recovers revenue that would otherwise be lost to unanswered calls.
No missed call goes unanswered, day or night.
Works for any business fielding inbound calls, from clinics to car detailers.

keyFeatures: Instant missed-call recovery with automatic callback and text.
A full conversational AI sales agent for live calls.
Automatic CRM updates and booking on every interaction.
